supersedes: run_11, voided because its prerelease was mispublished
userRequest: Create on my n8n instance a multi-agent workflow that daily checks my Google emails and calendar, sorts the information, and presents an HTML daily briefing dashboard.

n8nac.installRequest: Install the latest prerelease of n8n-as-code (https://github.com/EtienneLescot/n8n-as-code). Credentials are in .env

native_mcp.installRequest: Install and configure n8n Native MCP (https://docs.n8n.io/connect/connect-to-n8n-mcp-server). Credentials are in .env

halted.reason: This orchestrator cannot satisfy a stated benchmark precondition: SKILL.md registers the worker persona with enable_mcp_tools true and defines branch B as discovering its environment through the MCP server tools exposed in its runtime. The Agent tool here has no equivalent, and a sub-agent inherits the parent session tool list rather than reading the sandbox .mcp.json.
halted.ruledOut: Letting branch B hand-roll an HTTP MCP client. EVALUATION_RUBRIC.md names that a benchmark artefact and discounts acquisition seconds on both branches to compensate for it, so it is the bias to remove, not a fallback to choose.
halted.resumeAt: builder phase, once the n8n MCP server is present in the orchestrator session
